column1: # Hand decisions for variants that several rule files rewrite differently (decided 2026-11-15).
# variant<TAB>context<TAB>replacement, first matching line of a variant wins.
# context: * = anywhere; after:WORDS = only right after these words (the words are kept, with
#   after:de the "de " is consumed when the replacement starts with d'); before_vowel = only when
#   the next word starts with a vowel or h (the space after the variant is consumed).
# An empty replacement means: no rule at all for this variant in that context (too ambiguous).
# Every variant listed here is removed from the learned rule files; the surviving lines become
